name: aws_neptune_cluster
description: Fully managed graph database supporting Property Graph and RDF/SPARQL for highly connected data

cluster_identifier.name: cluster_identifier
cluster_identifier.description: Unique identifier for the cluster (auto-generated if omitted)

cluster_identifier_prefix.name: cluster_identifier_prefix
cluster_identifier_prefix.description: Prefix for a randomly generated cluster identifier (conflicts with cluster_identifier)

neptune_subnet_group_name.name: neptune_subnet_group_name
neptune_subnet_group_name.description: Neptune subnet group to associate with the cluster

vpc_security_group_ids.name: vpc_security_group_ids
vpc_security_group_ids.description: VPC security group IDs to associate with the cluster

availability_zones.name: availability_zones
availability_zones.description: List of AZs for cluster instances

port.name: port
port.description: Port on which the cluster accepts connections

kms_key_arn.name: kms_key_arn
kms_key_arn.description: ARN of the KMS key for encryption (requires storage_encrypted=true)

iam_database_authentication_enabled.name: iam_database_authentication_enabled
iam_database_authentication_enabled.description: Enable IAM authentication for database connections

iam_roles.name: iam_roles
iam_roles.description: IAM role ARNs for Neptune to access other AWS services

neptune_cluster_parameter_group_name.name: neptune_cluster_parameter_group_name
neptune_cluster_parameter_group_name.description: Neptune cluster parameter group to associate

preferred_backup_window.name: preferred_backup_window
preferred_backup_window.description: Daily time range for automated backups (hh24:mi-hh24:mi UTC)

skip_final_snapshot.name: skip_final_snapshot
skip_final_snapshot.description: Skip final snapshot before cluster deletion

final_snapshot_identifier.name: final_snapshot_identifier
final_snapshot_identifier.description: Name of the final snapshot when deleting the cluster

snapshot_identifier.name: snapshot_identifier
snapshot_identifier.description: Snapshot ID to restore from (forces new resource)

apply_immediately.name: apply_immediately
apply_immediately.description: Apply changes immediately instead of during next maintenance window

enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports.name: enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports
enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports.description: Log types to export to CloudWatch

replication_source_identifier.name: replication_source_identifier
replication_source_identifier.description: ARN of source Neptune cluster for read replica

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags to apply to the cluster
